entity_types.description: ED patients. Variant = acuity level; mixes over condition group, arrival mode, age band and payer are shared attributes. Target sources: CDC NHAMCS ED public-use file, CMS IPPS/OPPS tables, CDC FluView.

Staff roles. Named individuals are fictional (organizer clinician profiles when present in .private/, built-in stand-ins otherwise). Target sources: BLS OEWS wages, state nurse-ratio regulations, BLS absence rates, literature for productivity and fatigue.

Spaces. Counts for a specific hospital live in catalog/hospitals/<id>.yaml; positions in the layout file. Target sources: CMS Provider of Services, HCRIS cost reports, FGI design guidelines, literature for turnaround.
Equipment. Target sources: CMS OPPS payment rates for revenue per use; literature and manufacturer figures otherwise (many remain assumed).
Exogenous events. Target sources: CDC FluView for flu waves; literature otherwise.
